# Medigo — Grant Landscape Report
**Generated by GrantPilot · July 20, 2026**

## Profile assumptions (edit `profile.json` to re-target)

This sweep assumed Medigo is an **early-stage, US-based, for-profit digital-health startup**
(healthcare access / care logistics / telehealth), founder-led, **not yet SAM.gov-registered**,
seeking non-dilutive funding. An EU/Germany section is included in case Medigo is EU-based.
Fit scores are competitiveness estimates (0–100) for a strong application **under these
assumptions** — if the real product is (e.g.) organ-transplant logistics or a medical-travel
marketplace, tell GrantPilot and the scores shift materially (notes flag where).

| Program | Why excluded |

| FedEx Small Business Grant | **Program retired** after 2024 ([FedEx](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/small-business/grants.html)). Still widely listed on grant blogs — ignore them. |
| SBA Growth Accelerator Fund Competition | Funds **accelerators/ecosystem builders**, not startups directly ([CRS](https://www.congress.gov/crs-product/IF12310)). Use it to find funded accelerators near you instead. |
| Cigna Group Foundation 2026 calls | Youth-mental-health and veteran-housing rounds **closed** for 2026. |
| TEDCO SSBCI / BioAdvance Greenhouse | Credit-support and equity **investment** vehicles, not grants. |
| RWJF "Learning from Abroad" call | Researcher/policy-oriented, poor fit for a product startup. |

## Do these first (unlocks the biggest money)

1. **Register in SAM.gov → get a UEI** (free, 4–8 weeks — gates every federal grant). Then **SBA SBC registry** and **eRA Commons** (NIH) / **Research.gov** (NSF).
2. **Submit an NSF Project Pitch now** — free, 3 pages, 1–2 month feedback, no registrations needed to start.
3. **Complete 2 Verizon Digital Ready courses** (~1 hour) to enter the $10K monthly pool.
4. **Target Sept 5, 2026 NIH SBIR deadline** — 6 weeks out; feasible if started immediately.
5. **Join NASE** now so the 90-day clock runs before the next quarterly grant.
6. Tell GrantPilot the real product, state, and any ownership certifications (woman/veteran/minority-owned unlock the Amber Grant and a dozen set-aside programs not scored here) — then enable nightly auto-run to catch new postings as they open.

---
*Method: 9 parallel discovery sweeps (federal SBIR/STTR, Grants.gov health-IT, state programs, foundations, corporate, prize challenges, EU, rural/logistics niche) + screening of each hit for live status and Medigo fit, July 20, 2026. Deadlines verified against official pages where available — always confirm on the linked page before writing; funders change dates. GrantPilot drafts and screens; a human reviews and submits.*
